catalogDefinition.scope: Current independently orderable food and nonalcoholic products for Barking Mad at 239 Spectrum Avenue, Gaithersburg, Maryland 20879 across breakfast, lunch, brunch, dinner, pastry, coffee/tea, beverages, and exact-location Toast retail.
excludedCategories: alcoholic cocktails, wine, beer, and spirits
catalogDefinition.happyHourAssessment: The current exact-location official Happy Hour tab is enabled but contains no product rows. It contributes no separate products and does not justify importing alcoholic cocktail rows.
catalogDefinition.toastAssessment: The Toast surface is current and exact-location. Its service-period availability changes which restaurant rows are orderable at a given moment, so it corroborates the official service menus and contributes current pastry and retail products without narrowing the official catalog to the currently open daypart.
catalogDefinition.allergenBoundary: Direct named ingredient positives may be retained. No source establishes complete item allergen arrays, supported negatives, may-contain absence, or cross-contact outcomes.
catalogDefinition.rationale: The restaurant-issued Popmenu application currently enumerates complete breakfast, lunch, brunch, dinner, coffee/tea, pastry, and nonalcoholic beverage menus for the Gaithersburg location. The homepage is navigation only. The exact-location Toast catalog is accepted as a current linked-vendor alternate and supplemental presentation; current time gating explains why only some service periods are visible at once. Alcoholic rows, headings, separators, and non-product modifiers are excluded.
